text:
Recursive Self-Improving Loopers ( rse looper )

 
 

 A practical recipe for local loop-dynamics editing and self-improvement — producing Ex0bit/Inkblot-2-mini . 

 Eric E., Tensorbend.ai Research — November 26, 2026 

 TL;DR. Inkling-2-Mini runs Layers 6–17 three times per token by default. When we override the loop depth to 4 passes at inference time, accuracy drops to 3.1% on math and GSM8K with 95.3% repeat loops. rse looper edits only the BF16/FP32 loop-control weights (memory gates, MoE routers, short convolutions, and attention output projections) while leaving all 24.4B quantized experts untouched. Step 1 ( FP-Solve ) runs a closed-form Cholesky solve in 5.8 minutes on 1 GPU with zero backpropagation and zero labels. Step 2 runs 4 self-verified generations without an external teacher to produce Ex0bit/Inkblot-2-mini . Measured directly against untouched default 3-pass Base , Inkblot-2-mini improves locked DeepScaleR-Test ( 50.0% → 68.8% at 3 passes; 70.3% at 4 passes, n=64 ), LiveCodeBench v6 ( 34.4% → 40.6% , n=32 ), GSM8K ( 93.8% → 96.1% at 4 passes, n=128 ), and MMLU ( 82.5% → 83.5% , n=285 ), with exact identical parameters ( 26.39B ).

- Hugging Face Model (Public): 
- Paper (PDF): paper/main.pdf 
- Web Report: docs/index.html 
- Package: rse looper/ ( 8 clean modules, rse-looper CLI)

 

---

 1. What Breaks When You Override Loop Depth to 4 Passes

 thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini ( 26.4B total / 3.4B active parameters) runs Layers 6–17 3 times by default. Under our forced multi-pass inference wrapper ( LoopConfig(num passes=4) ), pushing the unmodified model to 4 passes causes severe instability: DeepScaleR-Test drops from 32/64 ( 50.0% ) to 2/64 ( 3.1% ), GSM8K drops from 120/128 ( 93.8% ) to 4/128 ( 3.1% ), and 95.3% of replies enter repeat loops.

We trace this instability to Layer 17 (the exit of the looped middle block). On Pass 3, one single direction reverses sign ( 75.5% of pass-shift energy). When Pass 4 feeds that flipped vector back into the 48 cross-pass memory gates, the average MLP memory gate drops from +0.638 to +0.067 .

 

---

 2. The Two-Step Recipe ( rse looper )

 Step 1: Closed-Form Loop-Dynamics Edit ( FP-Solve , 5.8 Minutes, 1 GPU, Zero Backprop, Zero Labels)
Because Layers 6–17 repeat on every token, every forward pass contains an internal alignment target: Pass 3 gives healthy outputs Y^(3) , and Pass 4 gives unstable outputs Y^(4) .

 rse looper/fpsolve.py disables gradients globally, runs 48 unlabeled prompts, and solves one closed-form null-space Cholesky equation per matrix across 168 BF16/FP32 tensors (all 48 memory-gate projections, attention output projections, and MoE routers in L6–L17 ). In 353 seconds on 1 GPU , pass-to-pass cosine similarity stabilizes through Pass 6 ( 0.949 → 0.972 → 0.989 ), 4-pass repeat loops drop to 0.0% , and performance improves directly over default 3-pass Base on GSM8K ( 93.8% → 96.9% , 124/128 ), LiveCodeBench v6 ( 34.4% → 37.5% , 12/32 ), 2025–2026 Olympiad ( 20.3% → 21.9% , 14/64 ), and WinoGrande ( 68.7% → 70.0% , 210/300 ), with 0.00 pp drift on ARC-Challenge ( 94.3% ) and HellaSwag ( 61.7% ).

 Step 2: Autonomous Multi-Generation Self-Improvement → Inkblot-2-mini 
With multi-pass loop dynamics stabilized, rse looper/gspo.py runs four self-verified generations without an external teacher:
1. Sample 6 solutions per hard math problem across 3 loop modes ( 3-pass , 4-pass , 2-step damped ) and grade them with our deterministic verifier ( rse looper/grader.py ).
2. Award a +0.35 bonus when deeper modes solve problems that 3-pass missed, and update only the 326 BF16/FP32 control and routing tensors ( 140s per generation) using sequence-level GSPO ratios with asymmetric clipping ( 0.20 / 0.28 ).
3. Gate every update on 64 hidden problems across all 3 loop modes ( 192 evaluations), keep only strict gains, and merge top accepted generations into Ex0bit/Inkblot-2-mini .

 

---

 3. Blind Held-Out Results (Compared Directly Against Default 3-Pass Base)

All edited checkpoints keep exact identical parameters ( 26,386,412,544 ), 1,244 identical safetensors keys, and 0 changed expert or vision weights ( results/integrity audit.json ).

install.title: Quick Start & Tests
install.html:
# Load the published public Hugging Face model directly
python3 -c '
import torch
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, Inkling2LoopForCausalLM
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("Ex0bit/Inkblot-2-mini")
model = Inkling2LoopForCausalLM.from_pretrained("Ex0bit/Inkblot-2-mini", dtype=torch.bfloat16, device_map="auto")
'

# Install rse_looper and run all unit and integrity tests
pip install -e ".[dev]"
pytest -W error -v

# Dry-run preflight check (verifies TF32 + causal_conv1d + config)
rse-looper --stage both --dry-run

# Run full autonomous local pipeline
rse-looper --stage both --base-model thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini --gpus 0,1,2,3,4,5 --require-causal-conv1d
